resources.string: Metrologist measures a flat surface, such as a wall, a door, a window or a patch of floor, from one photo. You lay a reference stick against the surface. This is a ruler with red and white stripes and a length that you know. You take the photo in the app and mark the four corners of the surface. Metrologist then shows the width, the height, the area, the diagonal and the corner angles, in metres, centimetres, or feet and inches. The result is an estimate, so check important sizes with a ruler or tape. The surface must be flat.
Metrologist does not collect personal data, and it does not upload your photos or measurements by itself. Everything is worked out on your phone.
Your photos stay on your phone, and the app does not save them to your gallery by itself.
The app has no internet permission, no analytics, no crash reports and no ads. The only permission it asks for is the camera.
If you tap Export, Android\'s share sheet opens and you choose where the picture goes. The privacy policy of the app you choose then applies.
See the source code on GitHub
No app on the phone can open this link. Install a web browser, then try again.
Metrologist is free and open source software, released under the Apache License 2.0.
It is built with OpenCV, CameraX, Jetpack Compose and Jetpack DataStore.
